products.title: Cena Skirt
products.body_html:
The softened color palette invokes feelings of a childhood summer, now long lost, but the memories remain. The Cena Skirt from Just in Case offers a banded graphic punch in a classic A-lined shape. Delicately textured fabric with crisp pleats at natural waist. Back zip closure. Color Black Stripe. 45% Cotton, 28% Polyester, 27% Viscose. Lana is wearing a French 36.

products.title: Robe Dress
products.body_html:
The Robe Dress is very flattering with princess seaming and shapely darts. Tea length. Open neckline with slight v, button placket at back. Invisible zip closure at left side. Side angled pockets at front. Capped sleeves. Lilith. Color Mist. 100% Polyester. 
Also available in Crisp.

products.title: Retenue Dress
products.body_html:
The Retenue Dress offers a wide neckline and a slightly oversized silhouette. Raglan seaming. Drawstring at back waist. Side angled pockets at front. Lilith. Color Black. 100% Polyester. 
Also available in Grenadine.

products.title: Short Jacket
products.body_html:
Made in Germany, the Rundholz Dip collection focuses on shape and volume while incorporating delicious materials. The Short Jacket is wrinkled to textured perfection. Button placket closure at front. Single pocket at right front. Color Mohne. 100% Cotton. Made in Germany. Ashley is wearing an X-Small.
Also available in Sahne.

products.title: Taban Coat in Phantom
products.body_html:
A sheath of durable cotton fabric, the Taban Coat is worked into a military look with two front patch pockets, vertical welted pockets and a double breasted button closure. Leather detailing is seen throughout the coat. Back vent at hem. Hannes Roether. Color Phantom. 100% Cotton, 100% Lamb Leather. Spencer is wearing a size Medium.
 Also available in Black.
